alt: A ring of seven weekday names, Monday through Sunday. A hand starts on Monday, ignores whole weeks, then steps forward (or back, for a negative day number) only the remainder modulo 7, landing on the day name that examples/weekday.py prints.

steps.caption: Day 0 is a Monday, so the hand starts on index 0. The week repeats, so the ring has 7 entries and the period is 7. The question is day 100.
100 = 7 * 14 + 2. Each full week of 7 days puts the hand back on Monday, so all 14 weeks can be ignored.
One more day: the hand moves to index 1, Tuesday.
One more day: the hand moves to index 2, Wednesday.
Day 0 is a Monday, so the hand starts on index 0. The week repeats, so the ring has 7 entries and the period is 7. The question is day 1,000,000,000,000.
1,000,000,000,000 = 7 * 142,857,142,857 + 1. Each full week of 7 days puts the hand back on Monday, so all 142,857,142,857 weeks can be ignored.
One more day: the hand moves to index 1, Tuesday.
Day 0 is a Monday, so the hand starts on index 0. The week repeats, so the ring has 7 entries and the period is 7. The question is day -1.
-1 is before day 0. Python gives -1 // 7 = -1 and -1 % 7 = 6, never a negative remainder, so the index stays inside 0 to 6.
One day back: the hand wraps around to index 6, Sunday.
